name: usage-hud
description: Shows 5-hour and 7-day usage (left or used) with reset times, and whether the prompt cache is hot or cold

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: auto uses 1h until Claude Code reports a different TTL; 5m or 1h forces it

theme.title: Look
theme.description: terminal is the default look (monospace phosphor strip) drawn in the desktop app, mobile and VS Code; clean is a minimal card; classic is the older neutral card; midnight, paper, sunset and mono are alternative looks; flat, pips and squares are simple looks; text draws text everywhere. The terminal app always draws text.

usage.title: Show usage as
usage.description: remaining shows how much of each limit is left (72% left); used shows how much is spent (28% used). The bars follow the same choice. The cache always shows time left.

keepWarm.title: Keep cache warm
keepWarm.description: on sends one short "warm" message into the chat when the hot prompt cache is under 5 minutes from expiring (1 minute on a 5m cache), so it stays warm. Each warm is a real turn and counts toward your usage. At most 3 in a row while you are away; typing anything starts the count over. Skipped when a limit is reached or nearly reached.
